title: Set up and check a folding utility cart
instruction: Lower the utility cart floor, slide both sidewall locks across their hinges, and press the sidewalls inward to check that they stay open.
context: The dbest Quik Cart Pro 01-803 has a hinged floor and captive lock bars that bridge both folding-wall hinges before transporting groceries or work supplies. A straight-looking wall can still fold inward while its bar is parked on one half.
setup: A full-size simulated dbest Quik Cart Pro 01-803 with a 432 × 406 × 432 mm molded polypropylene basket, both wall hinges partly folded inward, both stock bars retracted, floor raised, handle stowed and lid set aside. It stands unsupported by either gripper on a 700 × 780 mm work deck at 525 mm floor height. The stock YAM arm risers keep their standard 750 mm base height.
scoring: 0.25 for the seated floor within 2° of horizontal and resting on the cart support; 0.50 with both walls within 2° of straight; 0.75 with both captive bars moved at least 80 mm across their hinges; 1.0 when both attached wall ribs sustain more than 3 N inward for 0.75 s with both lock receivers transmitting that load, walls still within 2°, cart supported on the work deck, and both hands clear after release.
reset_notes: Remove any supplies, slide both rigidity bars off their hinge joins, raise the floor, and slightly fold the sidewalls inward.
fidelity: Manufacturer outer dimensions and stock-width floor, rails, sidewalls and hinge layout. Factory rail section and plastic friction estimated from primary references. Real setup and proof forces have not been measured on a physical specimen.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0 in 1,000 steps (seed 0). Scripted demo: 1.0 in 716 steps (seed 0).
